verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Statsig serves an llms.txt at docs.statsig.com that describes the official documentation. Statsig also documents a first-party Docs MCP server that lets AI clients read public docs from /api/mcp with no API key. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt contents or depth beyond its header (e.g., an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown index), independent community corroboration of agent use of these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.statsig.com/llms.txt # Statsig Documentation
Use the Statsig Docs MCP server to let supported AI clients read public Statsig documentation directly from /api/mcp.
The Docs MCP server reads documentation only and needs no API key.
